sentences.en: If it were not for water, humans could not survive.
sentences.zh: 如果没有水，人类无法生存。

sentences.en: All forms of life have an instinctive urge to survive.
sentences.zh: 所有形式的生命都有一个本能的求生意志。

sentences.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
sentences.zh: 小型企业必须紧缩开支才能生存下去。
